game.name: Just Cause (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: In Just Cause, an explosive action game for Xbox 360, you are Rick Rodriguez, a top secret agent on the verge of revolution. Choose from one hundred vehicles (helicopters, boats, motorbikes, mini-submarines, planes and cars) as you explore the 1,024 square kilometres of the tropical island of San Esperito!
